programme.desc: The Choreography Badge. The Squirrels have a dance-off with Chippo and the Rock Slippy Crew.

programme.title: Yukee

programme.desc: Honk Honk. Preschool series. The Teletubbies hear a 'honk honk' and the Tubby Car approaches. The Tubby Car drives them across Teletubbyland as they sing the Tubby Car song.

programme.title: Andy's Safari Adventures
programme.desc: Andy and the Naked Mole Rat. Preschool wildlife series. When Jen needs a scan of a naked mole rat but can't track down the one at Safari World, Andy jets off to the Sahara desert.

programme.title: The Game Catchers

programme.title: Vida the Vet

programme.title: Supertato

programme.title: Big Lizard

programme.desc: Stumpfest. Dad and his mates hit the backyard ready to rip up some tree stumps!

programme.desc: Caroline Munro welcomes all her cellar dwelling friends back for a night of fascinating films. First, is the 1962 horror The Cabinet of Caligari starring the late Glynis Johns, with Dan O'Herlihy.

programme.title: The Cabinet of Caligari
programme.desc: 1962. Horror. Directed by Roger Kay. Stars Glynis Johns, Dan O'Herlihy & Richard Davalos. A girl becomes trapped in the mysterious estate of Dr. Caligari after seeking help to repair a flat tyre.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Next up is a fast-paced horror film with plenty of typical 1980s ingredients. Caroline Munro introduces the 1982 feature Mortuary, starring Mary McDonough and David Wallace.

programme.title: Cellar Club with Caroline Munro
programme.desc: Set your alarms for next week, as Caroline gives us a look at the strange and scary films to enjoy next time.

programme.title: Mr Kingstreet's War
programme.desc: 1972. Thriller. During WWII, American couple Mr Kingstreet (John Saxon) and Maggie (Tippi Hedren), run a reserve that is located between British and Italian colonies in South Africa.

programme.title: A Chance to Learn
programme.desc: 1963. The boom of the clothing industry brought great work for female machinists. This film presents how new recruits were hired and then trained to use the sewing machine in the workshop.

programme.title: The Beverly Hillbillies
programme.desc: Elly Starts to School. 1963. Stars Donna Douglas, Joanna Barnes & Sharon Tate. Mrs. Drysdale recommends Elly for a top finishing school, hoping that humiliating her will drive the Clampetts away.

programme.title: Stagecoach West
programme.desc: Never Walk Alone. Western with Wayne Rogers & Robert Bray, who run a stagecoach line in the Old West where they come across a wide variety of killers, robbers and ladies in distress.

programme.title: Look At Life Clean Sweep
programme.desc: 1960. Exploring the effect of soot on our lives, especially on the erosion of buildings.

programme.title: Account Rendered
programme.desc: 1957. Thriller. Directed by Peter Graham Scott. Stars Honor Blackman, Griffith Jones & Ursula Howells. When a wealthy banker's wife is found murdered, the police find many suspects with a motive.

programme.title: Out of Town
programme.desc: Summer River Fishing/Village Fair. 1981. In the heat of a summer's day Jack goes fishing for roach in a drought-stricken river. He then visits his local village fair where they celebrate the past.

programme.title: Cause For Alarm!
programme.desc: 1951. Drama. Director: Tay Garnett. Stars Loretta Young, Barry Sullivan & Bruce Cowling. An unwell man accuses his wife and doctor of plotting to kill him, causing trouble after his sudden death.

programme.title: Look At Life Malta Milestone
programme.desc: 1964. A look at how Malta has sought new methods of generating income after the demise of the great naval dockyard. Also, a look at the future of the island before its independence day in 1965.

programme.title: River Beat
programme.desc: 1954. Crime drama directed by Guy Green. A radio operator is duped into smuggling diamonds and is caught by Customs Detective Baker (John Bentley). Starring Phyllis Kirk and Bill Nagy.

programme.title: Z-Cars
programme.desc: The Cinder Path. 1973. Stars John Slater, Ian Cullen, Douglas Fielding. Quilley and Skinner arrest drug pusher Jill, but former detective Neil Goss, now a solicitor, claims they planted the drugs.

programme.title: The Heart Within
programme.desc: 1957. Drama. Directed by David Eady. Stars James Hayter, Earl Cameron & David Hemmings. A murder suspect on the run must depend on strangers to help prove his innocence and clear his name.

programme.title: Look At Life Market Day
programme.desc: 1960. A look at the British country market, including cattle markets and the problems they face.

programme.title: The Brothers
programme.desc: Tender. 1976. Stars Jean Anderson, Colin Baker & Kate O'Mara. News that RAI Transport is going into liquidation smothers the Hammond grapevine. Jenny decides it is her chance to prove her form.

programme.title: It's Great to be Young
programme.desc: 1956. Musical. John Mills stars as a well-loved teacher in this gentle musical comedy portraying life in the 1950s British classroom and the school jazz band.

programme.title: The Switch
programme.desc: 1963. Crime. Directed by Peter Maxwell. Stars Anthony Steel, Zena Marshall & Conrad Phillips. A woman is abducted by a wristwatch smuggling gang who believe she knows too much.

programme.title: Fuel Limerick Use the Minimum
programme.desc: 1942. A short limerick, narrated by Kathleen Harrison, detailing the importance of cutting your fuel consumption to minimum during peak load hours!

programme.title: Strange But True
programme.desc: Psychic Detective Parts 2 & 3. 1996. Michael Aspel is back to continue the remarkable tale of one of the world's most successful psychic detectives, Dixie Yeterian.

programme.title: Scotland Yard
programme.desc: 1954. The Blazing Caravan. Director: Ken Hughes. Stars Edgar Driver, Alan Robinson & Betty Carter. A Salesman turns murderer after learning that his client has just won the football pools. (S1, E04)

programme.title: Van der Valk
programme.desc: The Runt. Stars Barry Foster, Joanna Dunham & Nigel Stock. A young thief becomes wealthy and appears to have connections in high places, Van der Valk must find out how the miracle occurred.

programme.title: Accident
programme.desc: 1967. Drama. Directed by Joseph Losey. Stars Dirk Bogarde, Stanley Baker & Jacqueline Sassard. An Oxford University professor yearns for an affair with his beautiful and enigmatic student Anna.

programme.title: The Silent Partner
programme.desc: 1978. Thriller. Director: Daryl Duke. Stars: Elliott Gould, Susannah York, Christopher Plummer, John Candy. A bank teller skims $50,000 during a robbery, but the crook wants it back.

programme.title: Blonde Fist
programme.desc: 1991. Drama. Director: Frank Clarke. Stars Margi Clarke, Carroll Baker & Ken Hutchison. Ronnie flees domestic life to find her father in New York and ends up boxing to make ends meet.

programme.title: Black Velvet Band
programme.desc: 1997. Drama. Director: Robert Knights. Stars Nick Berry, Todd Carty & Chris McHallem. A failed attempt to steal the crown jewels lands a band of crooks on a ship to Australia, but can they escape?

programme.title: A Lifetime Ago with The Baim Collection

programme.title: Black Saddle
programme.desc: 1959. Client: Starkey. Western with Peter Breck. After his brothers are killed in a shootout, a gunfighter decides to hang up his guns and uphold the law by becoming a lawyer.

programme.title: Look At Life Ups And Downs

programme.title: The Great Game

programme.title: Cinebox Memories

programme.title: Z-Cars

programme.title: The Black Knight

programme.title: Look At Life Down on the Farm
programme.desc: 1961. An in depth and intriguing look at the newest developments in farming of every kind.

programme.title: Crown Court

programme.title: Mark Saber

programme.title: That's My Boy
